mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile because it showed how oxygen can attach in the lungs and be released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the final components was straightforward, though a little repetitive after putting the red cells into plasma.

surprise.text: I was surprised that mature red blood cells have no nuclei.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the goals and pictures made the pairings clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if the next chapter shows where the blood goes and how it delivers materials. This chapter made me curious about that, though the assembly itself was fairly predictable.
